title: console lists: per-user list state (view tab order, filter state, sort, column widths) moves from localStorage and shared-view writes onto sys_user_preference ui.* keys; a toolbar sort or drag-reorder no longer rewrites the shared view
body:
Filing gate ③, a task the maintainer dispatched in person (chat, 2026-10-15). The maintainer asked 「这是主流类似系统的做法吗？浏览器侧的个人偏好——objectui 把视图顺序和每人每视图的筛选状态存在 localStorage」; the director seat answered that mainstream systems keep per-user list preferences on the server per user and offered 「是否立一张 objectui 卡做第一层（个人偏好上服务端、排序不写共享视图）？你一个字「立」我就立，归 objectui 车道。」; the maintainer's word: 「立」. Filed by the director seat (summon #37 continuation 2, `session_01LqNgdPZB2Jnr5HpGbaqLeB`). ⛔ Not a claim; triage may regrade.

**The problem in one sentence:** a console user's list preferences live in three places — the view tab order and the Filter panel's state in the browser's localStorage (gone on another device or after a cleared cache, no admin reset), favorites / recents / palette recents on the server under `sys_user_preference` `ui.*` keys (the cloud-synced adapter), and a user's sort click or view drag written INTO the shared view metadata through `client.meta.saveItem` — so one user's sort changes what every user sees, and under a walled posture (`group` / `isolated`) that write is refused by the platform (ADR-0131 D12 items 7–8: tenants do not write environment metadata), so a personal preference ends in an error.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` lane, one dev round in `@object-ui/app-shell` (plus `@object-ui/data-objectstack` if the adapter needs a new slot shape).

## Readings (objectui `origin/main` `28fb2a001`; objectstack `origin/main` `086fa4640`)

1. **View tab order:** `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:2739-2760` (`handleReorderViews`) writes `viewOrder:<object>` to localStorage first, then PATCHes `sortOrder` onto every saved view through `dispatchViewPatches` / `reorderViewPatches` (`:1102-1118`), the shared row, "so other sessions / users can pick up the order".
2. **Sort:** `:3745-3747` `onSortChange` → `persistViewPatch(viewDef.id, viewDef, { sort })` (the shared view, through `updateViewConfig` → `client.meta.saveItem`, a PUT on `/meta/view`, `:1168`) and `writeListUrlState({ sort })`.
3. **Filter panel state:** `:3752-3762` `onFilterChange` → `writeListFilterState(listFilterKey, …)` (localStorage, "SESSION state only", objectui#4155's rule that the builder's group never touches the view's stored body) and the URL (objectui#11860).
4. **Already on the server, per user:** `packages/data-objectstack/src/userState.ts` (`createObjectStackUserStateAdapter`: `resource` `sys_user_preference`, `(user_id, key, value)`, `load()` / `save()`, keys namespaced `ui.*`; one shared read per load, objectui#12187, pinned by `consoleUserPreferenceBudget.test.tsx`). Consumers today: `ui.favorites`, `ui.recent`, `ui.flow.palette.recents` (`ConsoleShell.tsx:331-341`).
5. **The object:** objectstack `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user-preference.object.ts` ("Per-user key-value preferences"), organization-owned rows, unique on `(organization_id, user_id, key)`: a data write, not a metadata write, admitted for a tenant's own user under every posture. Environment metadata writes under a wall are refused for everyone but the platform operator (`packages/metadata-core/src/meta-write-capability.ts`, `walledCatalogWriteVerdict`).
6. **Saved views in the console are metadata:** `ObjectView.tsx:2244-2247` reads them from `/meta/view` via `listViews`; there is no per-user or per-organization saved-view object (`sys_view_definition` retired as inert, ADR-0131 §7; per-user view scope is "a parked platform-side v18 direction").

## What to build (the first layer only: preferences, not personal views)

1. **One per-user list-state slot** on the existing adapter: key `ui.list.<object>`, value `{ viewOrder, perView: { [viewId]: { sort, filters, columnWidths? } } }`, written through `save()` and read in the same shared read as the three existing slots: the objectui#12187 budget stays ONE `sys_user_preference` read per console load (extend the pinned test; add no request). localStorage stays as the write-through cache and the no-adapter fallback (`load()` answering `[]` keeps today's localStorage path), so an adapter-less or offline host behaves as today.
2. **A user's sort and drag-reorder stop writing the shared view:** `onSortChange` and `handleReorderViews` write the user's slot (and the URL, objectui#11860, unchanged); `persistViewPatch` and the `sortOrder` PATCHes are reached only from the view editor (Studio, or an explicit "save view" action by a metadata author), never from a toolbar click. ⛔ The view's authored `sort` and the authored tab order stay the default for every user with no preference.
3. **Filter state** moves from the session-only localStorage key to the same slot, keeping objectui#4155's rule (the builder's group never touches the view's stored body) and the URL.
4. **Reset:** the toolbar's "Clear all" (filters) and a "Reset view" entry clear the user's slot for that view; an admin deletes the row in Setup → User Preferences (already navigable).
5. **Under a wall:** nothing new to build; the point of the move is that a tenant user's list preferences are organization rows and therefore allowed where metadata writes are refused. Measure it: a non-operator user on a `group` posture changes sort and order with no error and no change to the shared view (an adapter-level pin with the fake framework the budget test already uses, or a dogfood run).
6. ⛔ Not in this card: personal or shared *saved views* (`ViewItem.owner` was retired in 18; that is a protocol decision card if wanted); the Studio view editor; any change to `packages/spec`.

## Acceptance

- The objectui#12187 budget pin passes with the new slot included: still one `sys_user_preference` read per console load, every consumer receiving its own row.
- A pin that a toolbar sort or drag-reorder issues NO `/meta/view` write (the fake framework counts 0 PUTs) and one preference `save()`; the view editor's save still writes `/meta/view`.
- Cross-device: the same user in a second browser (fresh localStorage) sees their order, sort and filters after `load()`; another user sees the authored defaults.
- The walled-posture pin of item 5.
- `pnpm -r typecheck`, the app-shell suite and the `check:*` gates the repo's AGENTS.md lists.

## Dedupe

Titles of the last 300 objectui issues (all states) grepped for preference / localStorage / viewOrder / personal / per-user / filter state / column width / sortOrder: 1 hit, objectui#12212 (closed, the bell's object label; not this). Open issue bodies mentioning `sys_user_preference`, `viewOrder` or `localStorage`: 0. Precedents cited, all closed: objectui#4155 (the filter panel must not persist an overlay), objectui#11860 (filters, sort and grouping in the URL), objectui#5544 and objectui#12187 (the preference read budget). The GitHub search API is not available to this session; the dedupe is the repository listing above.

Related: objectui#4155 · objectui#11860 · objectui#12187 · objectui#5544 · objectstack ADR-0131 D12 items 7–8 · objectstack `walledCatalogWriteVerdict`.
